adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

valid_boroughs = set(valid_df['borough'])
N = len(valid_df)
print('Valid boroughs count:', N)

# Build undirected neighbor sets, then restrict to valid boroughs
neighbor_sets = {}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    n = row['neighbor']
    if b not in neighbor_sets:
        neighbor_sets[b] = set()
    if n not in neighbor_sets:
        neighbor_sets[n] = set()
    neighbor_sets[b].add(n)
    neighbor_sets[n].add(b)

valid_neighbors = {}
for b in valid_boroughs:
    if b in neighbor_sets:
        valid_neighbors[b] = {n for n in neighbor_sets[b] if n in valid_boroughs}
    else:
        valid_neighbors[b] = set()

# Global statistics over valid boroughs
values = valid_df.set_index('borough')['avg_no2_value']
global_sum = values.sum()
global_mean = values.mean()
global_var = values.var(ddof=0)  # population variance

print('Global population variance:', global_var)

    expected = m * global_mean
    # Variance of sum of m draws without replacement from population of N
    var_sum = m * (N - m) / (N - 1) * global_var
    std_sum = np.sqrt(var_sum)
    z = (local_sum - expected) / std_sum

        'local_sum': local_sum,
        'expected': expected,
        'z': z
    })
